messages:
sam_ops: FYI scheduling a controlled maintenance in eu-central-3 on Mon 23:00-00:30 UTC. Reason: apply NIC microcode + soft GPU driver reload to reduce packet-drop tail on high-QPS tenants.

maintenance-bot: Maintenance ticket created (m-euc3-2026-05-04). Subscribers notified.

nova_infra: Expected impact?

sam_ops: Plan is single-rack windows, 6min cadence. Each rack ~8-12m impacted; overall capacity dip ~7% rolling. We'll pre-seed KV cache to avoid cold starts.

eli_sre: Networking risk note: ToR reannouncements previously caused 30-90s egress spikes. We'll enable egress shaping and monitor queue depth. If egress queue >80% pause the rack.

maya_prod: I'll migrate realtime tenants with tag `tier:realtime` to dedicated-standby for the window. Will run a 12-tenant canary first.

ryan_fin: Cost: warm-standby backfill estimate +0.45% for the day if fully used. Set a spend alert at +0.8%. Approve?

sam_ops: Approved. Keep Finance alerted if fallback >30min.

eli_sre: On-call runbook snippets:
1) label node: `kubectl label node/$NODE maintenance=april`
2) drain: `kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120`
3) apply NIC update: `/opt/firmware/update_nic.sh --apply`
4) unload GPU driver and reboot if needed
5) post-unlock: run `ops/test/smoke_gen.sh --size 128` then uncordon

sam_ops: Abort criteria: p95 gen +125ms, error rate +5% sustained 10m, or egress queue >85% 3 checks. Fallback: move pending racks to eu-west-1 warm pool and stop the run.

maya_prod: Canary started tonight; will post results by 22:30 UTC.

eli_sre: Added dashboard panels for p95, KV hit-rate, and egress queue. I'll be on-call.

maintenance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Mon 23:00 UTC 1- m-euc3-2026-05-04. Channel: #eng-infra.

sam_ops: Final owners: Nova (warmup & runbook), Eli (monitoring & abort), Maya (migrations), Ryan (spend). I'll lead the run and comms. Postmortem template will be auto-created after completion.
